Twemoji attribution
===================

BrainVault uses Twemoji v17.0.3 graphics from the jdecked/twemoji project to render
Unicode emoji consistently across platforms.

Project: jdecked/twemoji
Graphics license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License text: LICENSE-GRAPHICS in the upstream project distribution

The application references version-pinned SVG assets from an external CDN at runtime.
